Third-party libraries, self-hosted so the site needs no outside CDNs.

- gsap.min.js, Draggable.min.js, InertiaPlugin.min.js: GSAP 3.13.0 (https://gsap.com), free under the GSAP Standard License (https://gsap.com/standard-license).
- lenis.min.js, lenis.css: Lenis 1.1.20 (https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2024 darkroom.engineering.
